title: Muse India Streams Hindi Dub for The God of High School Anime on YouTube

title: Crunchyroll Streams Sekiro: No Defeat Anime in India in January 2027
content: The anime screened in theaters in Japan for three weeks starting on September 4. Due to its popularity, more screenings are planned starting on October 2. The film opened at #9, and earned 99,842,200 yen (about US$649,000) in its first three days.
